metadata.notes: Non-toy E9_MULTI_METHOD: gf2_linear_algebra (Lean4 over ZMod 2) + sat_refutation (cake_lpr/HOL4) on the Tseitin C5 odd-charge parity system. Lean sha256=88135af30551e90a..., CNF sha256=62705cfd2009d454.... Both encodings validated against the same 2^5 truth table.

natural_language: The odd-charge Tseitin parity system on the 5-cycle C5 (e5+e1=1, e1+e2=0, e2+e3=0, e3+e4=0, e4+e5=0 over GF(2)) is unsatisfiable, established by two genuinely different formal methods. (1) gf2_linear_algebra (Lean 4): summing the five vertex constraints over ZMod 2, every edge variable occurs in exactly two of them and cancels in characteristic 2, so 0 = sum(charges) = 1 (tseitin_c5_unsat, via linear_combination whose residual is a universal ring identity). (2) sat_refutation (cake_lpr/HOL4): the same constraints are encoded as CNF, CaDiCaL produces an UNSAT proof, and cake_lpr accepts the LRAT certificate. Tseitin formulas are the canonical separator of these methods (exponential for resolution on expanders, linear for the GF(2) argument); the cycle instance keeps the SAT proof polynomial so both anchors are cheap. Two formal families (lean4, cake_lpr) and two distinct methods (gf2_linear_algebra, sat_refutation) -> E9.
title: Cross-method certificate — Tseitin C5 odd-charge parity is unsatisfiable
